label: late original-phase v/e/u/x/h/i input, gated by first token (q,l,y,a,2,p,1)
explanation: Fires only in the original (input) phase at positions t>=3 (mostly t=4-6), never at the delimiter or during copying, and never at t<3. The input token drives it: v is strongest (7x lift, 27% of mass), then e, u, x, h, i, with weaker d/m/j, and it is almost silent on other tokens. It is strongly modulated by sequence context, especially the first original token (q 4.9x, l/y/a about 3.5x, 2/p/1 about 2x). The top activations come from sequences that start with q/l/y/a, often with q early. First occurrences of the input token account for 92% of mass. The token x context predicate has high recall (85% with no context condition) but low precision, because the context dependence is graded and spread over several earlier tokens, so a first-token set only partly captures it (dev F1 0.54).
